assessment: This manuscript harnesses an organoid model of human neurulation to unravel the role of the Hippo signalling pathway in the specification of the three key ectodermal cell types. The authors then investigate how these mechanisms are dysregulated in an organoid model of Huntington's Disease. This work will be of broad interest to readers interested in the process of neurulation and how dysregulation of developmental mechanisms may lead to disease conditions in adulthood.
